m: परि-√ गा P. -जिगाति (aor. -अगात्, -गात्, -अगुर्), to go round or through, circumambulate, permeate, RV.; AV.; to enter (acc.), VS.; ĪśUp.; to come near, approach, reach, visit, afflict, RV.; MBh.; to go out of the way, avoid, shun, RV.; to disregard, neglect, AitBr.; to fail, miss, not to master or understand, BhP.
परि-√ गै P. -गायति, to go about singing, sing or celebrate everywhere, TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS.; to proclaim aloud (esp. Pass. -गीयते), MBh. &c.
a: परिगै — {c1c} P. To sing, relate, describe, celebrate, or proclaim.

m: परि-गीत mfn. sung, celebrated, proclaimed, declared, MBh.; BhP.
परि-गीति f. a kind of metre, Col.
a: परिगीति — f. A kind of metre.

v: parigUQa
tri॰ pari + guha kta । atyanvagupte tataH caturarTyAM fSyAdi॰ ka । parigUQaka tasyAdUradeSAdO tri॰ ।
a: परिगूढ — p. p. 1 Quite secret. --2 Incomprehensible, very difficult to understand.

m: परि-गूढक mfn. g. ऋश्यादि.
परि-ग mfn. going round, surrounding, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 38, Sch.
परिग-धिता f. firmly embraced, RV. i, 126, 6.
परि-√ गण् P. -गणयति (ind.p. -गण्य), to count over, reckon up completely, ascertain by calculation, Suśr.; Hcar.; BhP.; to calculate, reckon, consider, reflect, Megh. (cf. अपरिगणयत्).
a: परिगण् — {c10c} U. 1 To enumerate, count. --2 To consider, regard, think; अपरिगणयन् Me. 5.

m: परिगण m. or n. (?), a house, L.
परि-गणना f. complete enumeration, accurate calculation or statement, Megh.; Kull.
परि-गणनीय (Kull.) mfn. to be enumerated completely or stated accurately.

v: parigaRana
na॰ pari + gaRa--mAve lyuw । 1 sarvatoBAvena gaRane 2 viDinizeDaSAstrayoH viSezataH kIrttane ca
m: परि-गणन n.
a: परिगणनं --ना — Complete enumeration, accurate statement or calculation; श्रेणीभूताः परिगणनया निर्दिशंतो बलाकाः Me. (considered as an interpolation or क्षेपक by Malli.).

s: tri, (parisarvvatoBAvena gaRyate sma । pari + gaRa + kta .) sarvvatoBAvena gaRanAyuktaH । yaTA । “parigaRitavyatiriktezu saMsargakftaviSezo nAdaraRIyaH parigaRanAnarTakyAt .” iti jImUtavAhanaH ॥
v: parigaRita
tri॰ pari + gaRa--kta । 1 viDinizeDayo viSezarUpeRa kIrttite ca । 2 saMKyAte ca
m: परि-गणित mfn. enumerated, calculated, reckoned, BhP. (cf. अ-परिग्˚).
परि-गणितिन् mfn. one who has well considered everything, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 36, Kāś.
परि-गण्य (see अ-परिग्˚) mfn. to be enumerated completely or stated accurately.
परि-√ गद् (only inf. -गदितुम्), to describe, relate, tell, Bhām. ii, 75.

v: parigadita
na॰ pari + gada--kta । parikaTane tatkatamanena izwA॰ ini parinaditin tatkarttari ritrayAM NIp ।

m: परि-गदितिन् mfn. = परिगदितं येन सः, g. इष्टादि.

m: परि-गहन n. g. क्षुभ्नादि.
परि-गलित mfn. (√ गल्) fallen down, MBh.
sunk, Pañc.
flowing, fluid, melted, W.
a: परिगलित — p. p. 1 Sunk. --2 Tumbled or dropped down. --3 Vanished. --4 Melted. --5 Flowing.

m: परि-√ गम् P. -गच्छति (aor. -अगमत्, AV.; -ग्मन्, RV.; pf. -जग्मतुः, MBh.; p. -जगन्वस्, RV.; ind.p. -गत्या or -गत्य, RV.; ŚBr.; -गम्य, MBh.; inf. -गन्तुम्, R.), to go round or about or through, circumambulate, surround, inclose, RV. &c. &c.; to come to any state or condition, get, attain (acc.), MBh. : Pass. -गम्यते, MBh. : Caus. -गमयति, to cause to go round, to pass or spend (time), Ragh. viii, 91.
a: परिगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go or walk round; तं हयं तत्र परिगम्य Rām.; यथा हि मेरुः सूर्येण नित्यशः परिगम्यते Mb. --2 To surround; Śi. 9. 26; Bk. 10. 1; सेनापरिगत &c. --3 To spread everywhere, pervade all directions. --4 To attain to, obtain; वृषलतां &c. --5 To know, understand, learn; R. 7. 71. --6 To die, go forth (from this world); वयं येभ्यो जाताश्चिरपरिगता एव खलु ते Bh. 3. 38. --7 To overpower, affect; as in क्षुधया परिगतः. --Caus. To pass or spend (time).

m: परि-गम m. going round, surrounding, Bālar.
knowing, ascertaining, partaking of, occupation with (comp.), ib.; Pracaṇḍ.
spreading, extending, W.
obtaining, ib.
a: परिगमः, परिगमनं — 1 Going round, surrounding. --2 Spreading, diffusing. --3 Obtaining. --4 Knowing, determining, ascertaining.

m: परि-गमन n. id., MW.
परि-गमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) brought, conducted, driven, passed, spent (time), Ragh.
परि-गम्य mfn. accessible, to be circumambulated (अ-परिग्˚), KātyŚr.
परि-गन्तव्य mfn. to be got or obtained, L.
परि-√ गर्ह् Ā. -गर्हते, to blame greatly, censure, despise, abuse, MBh. : Caus. -गर्हयति id., ib.
परि-गर्हण n. excessive blame, censure, ib.
परि-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to roar, cry, scold, R.
परि-गर्वित mfn. (√ गर्व्) very proud or arrogant, Cāṇ.
परि-ग˚तार्थ mfn. acquainted or familiar with anything, Kālid.

s: tri, (pari + gam + kta .) prAptaH । vismftaH । jYAtaH । cezwitaH । iti medinI ॥ gataH । iti hemacandraH ॥ vezwitaH । yaTA, -- “aTa savalkadukUlakuTAdiBiH parigatojjvaladudDatabAlaDiH .” iti BawwikAvye । 10 । 1 ॥
v: parigata

m: परि-गत mfn. gone round or through, surrounded, encompassed, MBh.; R. &c.
filled, possessed of, visited by, afflicted with (instr. or comp.), ib.
diffused, spread, Kāv.
deceased, dead, Bhartṛ. iii, 49
experienced, known, learnt from (abl.), Kāv.
forgotten, L.
obtained, L.
= चेष्टित, L.
a: परिगत — p. p. 1 Surrounded, enclosed, encircled; Māl. 4. 10. --2 Diffused, spread around; Ś. 7. 35. --3 Known, understood; R. 7. 71; परिगतपरिगंतव्य एव भवान् Ve. 3; Mv. 3. 47. --4 Filled or covered with, possessed of (usually in comp.); Śi. 9. 26. --5 Got, obtained; Bh. 3. 52. --6 Remembered. --7 Overcome, overwhelmed. --8 Affected by, afflicted with; Pt. 1. 49. --9 Performed. --10 Forgotten. --11 Obstructed, hindered.

m: परि-गृद्ध mfn. very greedy, Divyāv.

v: parigfhIta
tri॰ pari + graha--karmaRi kta । svIkfte AcitA॰ nAsyAntodAttatA ।
m: परि-गृहीत mfn. taken hold of on both sides, AV.
surrounded, embraced, enclosed, enveloped, fenced, TS.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
seized, grasped, taken, received, obtained, accepted, adopted, admitted, followed, obeyed, Br.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
opposed, checked, W.
परि-गृहीत m. g. आचितादि.
a: परिगृहीत — p. p. 1 Grasped, seized, clutched. --2 Embraced, surrounded. --3 Accepted, taken, received. --4 Assented or consented to, admitted. --5 Patronized, favoured. --6 Followed, obeyed, observed. --7 Married.

m: परि-गृहीतृ w.r. for ˚ग्रह्˚.

m: परि-गृहीति (परि-), f. grasping, comprehension, TS.; Br.
a: परिगृहीतिः — f. Ved. 1 Grasping, comprehension. --2 Summing up.

v: parigfhyA
strI pari + graha--karmaRi kyap । pARigfhItAyAM striyAM Sabdaca॰ ।
m: परि-गृह्या f. designation of a partic. kind of Vedi or sacrificial mound, Kauś.
a married woman, L.
1. परि-गृह्य ind. having taken or seized, in company or along with (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
considering, regarding, W.
2. परि-गृह्य mfn. to be taken or accepted or regarded, W.
परि-गृह्य—वत् (˚गृह्य-), mfn. containing the word परिगृह्य, TS.
परि-ग्लान mfn. (√ ग्लै) wearied out, languid, exhausted, MBh.; R. &c.
averse from (dat.), Pat.
a: परिग्लान — p. p. 1 Languid, exhausted. --2 Averse from, disinclined to.

s: puM, (pari + grah + “parO yajYe .” 3 । 3 । 47 । iti GaY .) yajYavediviSezaH । iti kecit ॥
v: parigrAha
pu॰ pari + graha--“parO yajYe” pA॰ GaY । yajYArTe sPyena vedeH svIkAre si॰ kO॰ ।
m: परि-ग्राह m. the surrounding or fencing round of the Vedi or sacrificial altar with three lines or furrows, TS.
a: परिग्राहः — The fencing round of the sacrificial altar.

m: परि-ग्राहक mfn. favouring, befriending, Bālar.
परि-ग्राह्य mfn. to be treated or addressed kindly, MBh.

v: parigrAma
avya॰ grAmasyABimuKam । grAmasyAmuKye tataH BavAdyarTe WaY । pArigrAmika tadBavAdO tri॰ ।

m: परि-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, ˚णीते (Impv. 2. sg. -गृहाण, MBh.; Kālid.; impf. -अगृह्णाः, RV.; 3. sg. -अगृह्णत्, TS.; 3. pl. -अगृह्णन्, AV.; Ā. -अगृह्णन्त, MBh.; pf. 1. sg. -जग्रभ, RV.; 3. sg. -जग्राह, MBh. &c.; ind.p. -गृह्य, ŚBr.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.), to take hold of on both sides, embrace, surround, enfold, envelop, VS.; AV.; Br.; MBh. &c.; to fence round, hedge round, TS.; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; to occupy on both sides (सरस्वतीम्), MBh.; to seize, clutch, grasp, catch, ib.; to put on, wear (as a dress or ornament), ib.; to take or carry along with one, ib.; Kāv. &c.; to take possession of, master, overpower, RV.; AV.; Br.; Var.; to take (in war), take prisoner, conquer, MBh.; to take (food), ŚBr.; to receive, (also as a guest) accept, ib.; MBh.; Śak.; BhP.; to take, adopt, conform to, follow, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to take by the hand, assist, MBh.; to take (a wife), marry, Śak.; Pañc.; to surpass, excel, Mn.; Prab.; (in Ved. gram.) to enclose (इति) between a word twice repeated, RPrāt. (cf. परि-ग्रह).
a: परिग्रह् — {c9c} P. 1 To clasp round, embrace. --2 To encircle; surround, fence or hedge round. --3 To lay hold of, seize. --4 To take, assume. --5 To accept. --6 To favour, patronize; देवेन च परिगृहीतः M. 1; 1. 13. --7 To support, assist, guide; राक्षसमतिपरिगृहीतः Mu. 1. --8 To put on (a dress). --9 To take possession of, master, overpower. --10 To conceive, comprehend. --11 To undertake. --12 To receive hospitably. --13 To take (a wife), marry; Ś. 5. 19. --14 To conform to, follow. --15 To surpass, excel.

m: परि-ग्र˚हार्थीय mfn. having the sense of comprehension i.e. generalization, Nir. i, 7.
परि-ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be admitted or supposed, Śaṃk.
to be ruled or controlled, Pat.
to be taken hold of or got into possession, Vajracch.
परि-ग्रहीतृ mfn. taking hold of, seizing
परि-ग्रहीतृ m. assister, helper, VāyuP.
ruler, Pat.
an adoptive father, Pravar.; Kull.
a husband, Śak.
a: परिग्रहीतृ — m. 1 A husband; Ś. 4. 21. --2 An assistant. --3 An adoptive father.

s: puM, (parigrahaRamiti । pari + graha + “graha vfdfniScigamaSca .” 3 । 3 । 58 । iti ap .) pratigrahaH । (yaTA, paYcatantre । 4 । 7 । “kaRWASlezaparigrahe SiTilatA yannAdarAccumbase tatte DUrtta ! hfdi sTitA priyatamA kAcinmamevAparA ॥”) sEnyapaScAdBAgaH । patnI । BAryyA । (yaTA, raGuH । 9 । 14 । “samanukampya sapatnaparigrahAnanalakAnalakAnavamAM purIm ॥”) parijanaH । parivAraH । AdAnam । (yaTA, raGuH । 9 । 46 । “anuBavannavadolamftUtsavaM pawurapi priyakaRWajiGfkzayA । anayadAsanarajjuparigrahe BujalatAjalatAmavalAjanaH ॥”) svIkAraH । (yaTA, raGuH । 18 । 38 । “lokena BAvI pitureva tulyaH samBAvito mOliparigrahAt saH ॥”) mUlam । kandaH । SApaH । SapaTaH । ityamaraBaratO ॥ rAhuvaktrasTaBAskaraH । ityajayaH ॥ (puttradArAdiBarttavyaparimARam । yaTA, manuH । 10 । 124 । “prakalpyA tasya tErvfttiH svakuwumbAd yaTArhataH । SaktiYcAvekzya dAkzyaYca BUtAnAYca parigraham ॥” parigfhyate'neneti vigrahe hastaH ॥ vizRuH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 149 । 58 । “ftuH sudarSanaH kAlaH paramezWI parigrahaH ॥” “SaraRArTiBiH parito gfhyate sarvvagatatvAt parito jYAyata iti vA । puzpAdiBirBaktErarccitaM parigfhRAti iti vA parigrahaH ॥” iti SANkaraBAzyam ॥ sADanam । yaTA, raGuH । 9 । 21 । “ajinadaRqaBftaM kuSameKalAM yatagiraM mfgaSfNgaparigrahAm ॥” “mfgaSfNgaM parigrahaH kaRqUyanasADanaM yasyAstAm ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM mallinATaH ॥)
v: parigraha

pu॰ pari + graha--ap । 1 svIkAre । karmaRi Ta । 2 sEnyapaScAdBAge 3 BAryyAyAM parijane ca । karaRe Ga । 4 mUle 5 SapaTe ca amaraH । paritoH grahaH । 6 rAhuRA sUryenGorgrahaRe 7 vizRO pu॰ “paramezWI parigrahaH” vizRusaM॰ “SaraRArTiBiH parito gfhyate sarvagatatvAt parito jYAyate iti vA patrapuzpAdikaM BaktErarpitaM gfhRAtIti vA parigrahaH” BA॰ ।
m: परि-ग्रह m. (ifc. f(आ). ) laying hold of on all sides, surrounding, enclosing, fencing round (esp. the Vedi or sacrificial altar by means of three lines or furrows), ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
wrapping round, putting on (a dress &c.), assuming (a form &c.), Kāv.
comprehending, summing up, sum, totality, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.
taking, accepting, receiving or anything received, a gift or present, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
getting, attaining, acquisition, possession, property (ifc. ‘being possessed of or furnished with’), ib.
household, family, attendants, retinue, the seraglio of a prince, ib.
a house, abode, Hariv.
root, origin, foundation, MBh.
admittance (into one's house), hospitable reception, Mn.; MBh.; R.; Kāraṇḍ.
taking (a wife), marrying, marriage, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a wife (also collect.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
choice, selection, ib.
understanding, conception, Pāṇ., Sch.
undertaking, beginning, commission or performance of, occupation with, Mn.; R.; Hariv.
homage, reverence, grace, favour, help, assistance, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dominion, control (ifc. ‘dependent on, subject to’), R.; Var.; MārkP.
force, constraint, punishment (opp. to अनु-ग्रह), R.
claim on, relation to, concern with (loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in Ved. gram.) the double mention of a word both before and after इति
the form which precedes इति, RPrāt.
a curse, imprecation, oath, L.
an eclipse of the sun, L.
the rear or reserve of an army, L. (v.l. प्रति-ग्र्˚)
